title: Figure 8. Atlas IIAS Impacts with Breakup (simulated impact scatter map)
description: Rotated coastline outline map overlaid with a scatter of simulated impact points, truncated on one side and concentrated near the coast. A rotated in-figure label reads "Atlas IIAS Impacts, Random-Attitude Failures at 130 sec., Thrust to 280 sec., Breakup q-alpha = 5,000 deg-lb/ft2." It is the companion to Figure 7 (no breakup).
